tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi byin rlabs kyi cho ga bar chad kun sel bzhugs so// bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la 'dir dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud las 'ongs pa'i rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs bya ba la don gsum ste/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po ni/ dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su/ 'di nyid bris sku la sogs pa yod na dgram/ de'i mdun du cog tse la sogs pa'i stegs bu'i khar/ maṇḍal ras la sogs pa la chu tshon gyis bris pa'am/ rdul tshon gyis bris kyang rung bas chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po nyis rim rtse mo rang la bstan pa'i mthar me ri kha dog sna tshogs sam ljang khu gang rung gis bris/ de'i mthar khyams gru bzhi nyis rim du bris pa'i nang / shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba/ phyi'i re khā nyis rim gyi bar sngon por bya'o/ /maṇḍal gyi steng du rin po che la sogs pa'i snod du dpal gtor gsum cha zlum po/ sum gnyis gru gsum dbal dang bcas pa mtha' mtheb skyus bskor ba/ 'bri mog gi kha dog dmar por bsgyur ba la mda' dar dmar po gzugs/ spros pa la dga' na bla ma kha cig gi phyag len la gtor ma'i rtser rta mgo ljang zhur/ rngog ma dmar por yod pa zan la bcos pa 'dzugs par mdzad pas de ltar byas kyang rung ngo / de'i mdun du/ bla ma/ yi dam/ chos skyong / gzhi bdag dang bcas pa'i gtor ma zlum po mtheb skyus bskor ba gsum mam bzhi bsham/ mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga'am bdun nam mtha' bskor du bsham/ bgegs gtor cog zlum zhig kyang zur du bzhag tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i yo byad dang / slob dpon gyi mdun du nang mchod dang / rdo rje dril bu/ ḍā ma ru/ me tog la sogs pa nye bar mkho ba thams cad ma tshang ba med par bzhag go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ slob dpon gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/

bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa dkyus bzhin byas la/ mdun gyi maṇḍal gtor ma dang bcas pa/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swabha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dpal rta mgrin dam tshig par bskyed/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas spyan drangs la stim/ mchod bstod/ bzlas pa/ gtor ma 'bul ba rnams bya'o/ /de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod/ las kyi rdo rjes bgegs gtor la chab btang / slob dpon gyis/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo/ sogs sam/ a ka ro lan gsum gyis bgegs la gtor ma byin/ rang rta mgrin du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas me mtshon khro bo'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ bgegs thams cad nam mkha'i mtha' klas par bskrad cing tshar bcad par bsam la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas/ ngag tu/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi bka' bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang / khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa'i lha tshogs/ dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la dbang bskur ba zab mo bsgrub pa la mi dbang ba de dag thams cad phyogs 'dir ma gnas par rgyang ring du song zhig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag thams cad me mtshon khro bo'i lha tshogs 'di rnams kyis skad cig nyid la thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bya'o/ /oṃ hrīḥpadma ta krita sogs drags sngags rnams brjod cing / yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug cing rol mo'i sgra drag po bya'o/ /de nas las kyi rdo rjes maṇḍal gyi me tog bkye bsdu bya/ slob dpon yi dam gyi nga rgyal drag po dang ldan pas slob ma rnams la 'di skad gdams par bya ste/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir dang /

khyad par du yang lam bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad mtha' dag zhi ba dang / mthun rkyen thams cad bde blag tu bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa gsang bsgrub bam shangs lugs sam/ skyer sgang lugs sam/ zhabs brgyad par grags pa 'di nyid kyi dbang bskur ba'am/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa zab mo zhus la nyams su blang snyam pa byang chub tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par mdzod/ de la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos thams cad theg pa rim pa dgu'i chos su 'dus pa las/ 'dir bskyed pa ma hā yo ga'i chos bskor/ de'ang sgrub sde chen po brgyad yod pa las/ padma gsung gi chos skor/ de'ang rta mchog rol pa dang / padma dbang bde gshegs 'dus pa/ gsang ba 'dus pa/ bdud rtsi thigs pa la sogs pa mang du yod pa las/ rta mchog rol pa'i skor/ de la phyi sgrub/ nang sgrub/ gsang sgrub gsum las/ 'dir shin tu byin rlabs che ba'i gsang sgrub zab mo 'di nyid kyi byung tshul lo rgyus la/ dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi chig brgyud rdo rje'i rgyas pa'i brgyud pa rin po che bdun du grags pa'i nang tshan/ brgyud pa lnga pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam sprul/ grub thob chen po dbon ston skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge de nyid kyis thugs dam 'od gsal chos sku'i ngang nas dag pa'i zhing khams du ma gzigs/ sangs rgyas byang sems mang po la chos gsan/ khyad par shing pho rta'i lo dgun zla ra ba'i tshes bcu bdun gyi tho rangs rnal lam du bzung nas nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul du byon pas/ slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas dang mjal nas deng sang bod yul na chos sgrub pa la spyir lha srin sde brgyad/ khyad par rgyal gdon 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kyi bar chad che bar yod pas/ de dag gi gnyen por gyur pa'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub pa zab mo gcig zhu byas pas/

slob dpon skad cig de nyid la rta mgrin zhal gsum phyag drug pa gcig tu gyur nas rta skad thengs gsum bton pas snang srid kyi ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad 'dus nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa tshul bzhin byas/ dus de nyid du/ slob dpon padmas dbon ston skyer sgang pa la rta mgrin de nyid kyi dbang bskur ba gnang ngo / /de'i tshe slob dpon gyi zhal nas ngas rta mgrin gyi sgrub pa brgya rtsa brgyad kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud las btus pa'i gsang sgrub zab mo gcig snye mor gter du sbas pa sngags pa gcig gis gter nas thon yod pas der zhus cig rgyal po dpe dkar dkor 'dre 'byung po'i tshogs rnams dang lha srin sde brgyad thams cad 'joms par bzhed do/ /zhes lung bstan pas/ snye mor byon nas slob dpon sngags pa rgya gong ri pa zhes bya ba la rta mgrin gsang sgrub 'di nyid zhus so/ /de nas yang rnal lam bzung nas slob dpon padma la zhus pas lan gsum gyi bar du da rung 'khor lo ma byin par 'dug pas zhus cig gsung bas/ yang nyi khri dang / bur btang dang / de rnam gnyis phul nas zhus pas 'khor lo yang gnang / 'di nyid kyis grub pa thob cing 'gro phan rgya che bar byung bas rta mgrin skyer lugs pa zhes phyogs thams cad du grags par gyur/ de la snyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gyis 'di nyid zhus nas bsgrubs pas/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig na zhal mngon sum du gzigs shing lung bstan thob/ dkar chung rgyal po la sogs pa dkor bdag 'khrugs te/ gnod pa'i smyon pa brgyad cu tsam btul/ gzhan yang lha srin gdug pa can dam la btags/ de la sangs rgyas ston pas zhus nas bsgrubs pas zhal mngon sum du gzigs/ 'byung po mang po btul zhing dam la btags/ khyad par 'di'i sgo nas dkar chung rgyal po btul bas rgyal po de nyid spre'u'i lpags pa'i gos dang stag gi sham thabs gyon/

bya pho gcig khrid nas phyag zhung zhung 'bul zhing bdag rjes su bzung 'tshal zer ba dus de nyid du dam la btags/ de'i nang bar sangs rgyas snyan ston gyi gsung nas mdang dkar chung rgyal po de ltar byed pa de kho na gting nas mos shing thul ba yin gsung / de ltar rim gyis brgyud nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams par byon pa'i yi dam khyad par can 'di nyid kyi dbang bskur ba'am/ byin gyis brlabs pa zab mo sgrub par byed pa la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub zin nas slob mar bya ba'i rim pa la/ thog mar yon dbul zhing gsol ba btab pa'i slad du/ da ltar gyi slob dpon 'di nyid dpal rta mchog rol par gsal ba la de nyid kyi byin rlabs zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po/ /'jig rten gsum gyi 'dren mdzad lha/ 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /rdo rje bla ma mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum rjes bzlos bya/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal rta mgrin la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i sgo nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed snyam pas/ 'di'i rjes bzlos lan gsum brjod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs lan gsum brjod/ byin rlabs kyi dngos gzhi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba ni/ mdun gyi maṇḍal gtor ma dang bcas pa dbyer med pa las/ chos 'byung gru gsum dmar nag phyi rol nas ye shes kyi me dpung kha dog sna lnga 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i dbus su/ padma nyi ma klu brgyad bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng du khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mchog ces sogs mngon rtogs ltar gsal btab/

de'i steng gi nam mkha' la slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge la sogs pa rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams dang / mtha' skor kun tu yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar mngon sum du bzhugs par bsam/ /bla ma yid dam ngo bo tha mi dad pa la rang gi lus longs spyod thams cad phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul nas mchod par bsam la/ bla ma rin po che bdag la bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/ sku'i byin rlabs lus la zhugs su gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon rta mgrin du gsal ba dang / mdun gyi rta mgrin gnyis char gyi dpral ba nas 'od zer dkar po bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ba'i sna la/ rta mgrin dkar po 'jigs shing rngam pa sku chung la yan lag rags pa dpag tu med pa byung nas/ khyed rang rnam pa'i spyi bo nas thogs med du zhugs shing thim pas lus kyi nang thams cad khengs/ nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhal du dmar chom chom gsol/ sku lus kyi me dpung gis gzhob thul bsregs/ mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis btub/ rdo rje'i gar mdzad/ sngags kyi sgra bsgrags pas lus sems la bde chen gyi ye shes bskyed/ khro bo'i rgyal po'i sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang bskur thob pa'i mos pa gyis shig brda' sprad la/ slob dpon gyis oṃ hrīḥpadma ta krid sogs sngags kyi mthar phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang / khyad par du yang bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mchog rol pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la dus da lta nyid du myur ba nyid du 'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig

nad gdon sdig sgrib 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs shig mthun rkyen legs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis rlobs shig ces pa'i mthar sngags rnams drag tu brjod cing / gu gul gyi dud pas bdug ḍā dril gyis sna drangs pa'i rol mo'i sgra chen po bya'o/ /de bzhin du gsang ba'i dbang dang / gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la zhes pa'i gsol ba btab/ mgrin pa nas 'od zer dmar po'i sna la rta mgrin dmar po byung / mgrin pa nas zhugs gsung gi byin rlabs dang gsang ba'i dbang thob par mos la sngags rol bya/ yang mchod/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang thugs kyi byin rlabs la yid la ces gsol ba btab/ snying ga nas 'od zer mthing ga'i sna la rta mgrin mthing kha byung / snying gar thim pas yid kyi sdig sgrib dag thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob par bsams la sngags rol bya/ yang mchod/ dbang bzhi pa dang / sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs lus ngag yid gsum la ces sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ lte ba nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi sna la rta mgrin dkar dmar mthing gsum byung / lte bar thim pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ dbang bzhi pa thob par bsam la sngags rol bya'o/ /lha dngos kyi byin gyis brlab pa ni/ mdun gyi maṇḍal steng gi gtor ma slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ gtor ma de nyid dpal rta mgrin dngos su gsal ba'i steng gi nam mkha' la brgyud pa'i bla ma/ g.yas na dpa' bo bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ g.yon na dpa' mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ sku dges pa'i gar mdzad/ gsung sngags kyi sgra sgrogs/ thugs bde gsal rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang nas/ khyed rang rnams la brtse ba chen pos dgongs shing byin gyis brlabs bzhin 'ur 'ur chem chem zhugs pas khyed rnams la gnod cing 'tshe ba bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad zhal du dmar chom chom gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/

ces brda sprad la/ sngags rnams kyi mthar/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge snyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub shangs ston chen po/ mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum pa/ khyung po tshul khrims mgon po/ bya thang ri khrod ras chen/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rdo rje/ pha rgod mthar pa'i mtshan can/ drin can sangs rgyas rnam rgyal la sogs pa phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma zhes pa nas/ 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlabs/ zhes pa'i mthar bye brag tu yang rdo rje slob ma 'di nyid la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar gyi gnod pa/ 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa/ bar gdon bdud btsan ma mo rgyal 'gong the'u rang 'byung po'i gnod pa thams cad dus da lta nyid du zhi ba dang tshar gcod par mdzad du gsol/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du srung ba dang / skyob pa dang / sba bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing / spos rol byas pas mdun gyi mtha' skor gyi lha tshogs rnams rta mgrin la thim/ de nyid slob ma'i spyi bo nas thim pas slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum dang / rta mgrin gyi sku gsung thugs dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres nas slob ma rta mgrin dngos su gyur par bsam la/ de'i nga rgyal la ji tsam gnas kyi bar du 'dzin med du mnyam par 'jog sngags bzlas pa'i lung sbyin pa ni/ mdun gyi rta mgrin dang / slob ma rta mgrin du gsal ba gnyis char gyi thugs kar hūm̐ dmar po'i rtse mor hrīḥdamar po re re bsam/ rta mgrin gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar bzla bya'i sngags kyi phreng ba kha dog dmar po sngags kyi sgra sgrog cing me 'bar bzhin pa bsam la/ slob mas slob dpon la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ bcom ldan bdag la bstsal lags kyis/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum rjes zlos bya/

slob dpon gyis yi dam la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ mdun gyi rta mgrin gyi thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng rnams las/ sngags 'phreng mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi rnam par byung zhal nas thon/ slob ma rta mgrin du gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi sa bon gyi mthar g.yas skor du 'khod par bsam la lan gsum gyi rjes zlos byas pas/ dang pos dam tshig pa/ gnyis pas ye shes pa/ gsum pas brtan zhing rgyas gdab pa'i tshul du bsam la/ slob dpon gyis 'phreng ba la 'jus te rtsa sngags khams gsum dbang sdud kyi sngags las sbyor gyi sngags rnams bzlas pa'i mthar/ slob dpon gyis phreng ba'am/ me tog slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag nas/ khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mgrin gyi thugs rje nus pa sngags kyi byin rlabs thams cad slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la 'jug par gyur gcig zhes brjod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang / gtang rag gi maṇḍal/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ des khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa gsang sgrub skyer sgang lugs zhes bya ba de'i rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod/ gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga ni/ tshogs 'khor yod na tshul bzhin bya/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol ba'am/ bris sku la brtan bzhugs bya/ bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas gdab/ bkra shis rgyas par bya'o/ /de ltar dpal rta mgrin gsang sgrub skyer sgang lugs kyi byin rlabs kyi cho ga bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba 'di nyid las dang po pa'i rdo rje slob dpon rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i ched bklag chog tshul du lam 'di'i rig pa 'dzin pa blo gsal gyis rang gi bsti gnas su sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 tshar chen rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho/
